jobText:
Role: Vice President of Engineering
Location: New York, NY (Hybrid)

About the Role:
We are seeking a visionary Vice President of Engineering to lead and scale our global engineering organization. In this role, you will partner directly with our Executive Leadership Team and Board of Directors to drive technical vision, organizational excellence, and product execution across our flagship SaaS portfolio.

Executive Responsibilities:
- Lead, inspire, and grow an organization of 100+ software engineers, managers, and directors across multiple international hubs.
- Oversee total departmental budget ($15M - $25M), establishing operational rigor and resource allocation strategies.
- Define engineering strategy, driving high-velocity delivery with robust security, compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001), and reliability.
- Partner with Chief Product Officer and Go-To-Market executives to align technical roadmaps with company revenue targets.
- Represent engineering at Board meetings and investor presentations.

Requirements:
- 15+ years of software engineering experience, including 8+ years of senior managerial leadership (VP or Director level).
- Demonstrated track record of scaling engineering organizations from growth stage through enterprise maturity.
- Deep financial acumen and experience managing large capital and operational expenditure budgets.
- Exceptional executive communication and talent acquisition capabilities.
